# Pool

> Object pool for reusable instances.

- Package: `Pool` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Pool")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Pool")` on the client

## `Gaxia.Pool`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/Pool.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local Pool = Gaxia.Pool
-- or, to get its types in your own ModuleScript: local Pool = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages.Shared.Pool)
```

### Functions

- `Pool.new<T>(factory: () -> T, reset: ((obj: any) -> ())?): PoolObject<T>`
  factory: builds a fresh object on a pool miss. reset: (optional) called on Return() to scrub state before parking. Get() returns the factory's declared type: cast a template clone in the factory (`function(): BasePart return template:Clone() :: BasePart end`). `reset` takes `any` so a reset typed for the concrete class is accepted whatever the factory infers.

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type PoolObject<T = any> = {
    Get: () -> T,
    Return: (obj: T?) -> (), -- nil is ignored
    PreWarm: (n: number) -> (),
    Clear: () -> (), -- destroys parked Instances
    Size: () -> number, -- parked (available) objects
}
```
